# InviteStory — Premium Digital Wedding Invitation Websites for Indian Couples

> InviteStory (https://invitestory.in) helps couples create premium digital wedding invitation websites with Google Maps navigation, photo galleries, countdown timers, 1-click Google Calendar sync, and WhatsApp sharing. Couples select from 21 culturally-curated templates (Royal Palace, South Indian, Nikah, Walima, Hindu Muhurtham, Ghibli Animation, Beach, Garden), send their event details over WhatsApp, and receive a live custom web invite link within 24 hours.

## Core Value Proposition & Key Features
- **InviteStory Definition:** InviteStory helps couples create premium digital wedding invitation websites with Google Maps navigation, photo galleries, countdown timers, 1-click Google Calendar sync, and WhatsApp sharing.
- **One Day, One Wedding Event:** Focuses strictly on the main wedding event. Sub-moments (Baraat, Pheras, Jaimala, Nikah ceremony) fit inside the single-day timeline to eliminate multi-day schedule clutter.
- **No RSVP Friction:** Indian wedding guests are invited personally or via phone/WhatsApp. InviteStory removes annoying RSVP forms or WhatsApp confirmation buttons—the invite link acts as an elegant announcement and digital hospitality card.
- **Built-in Google Calendar & Maps:** Every template features one-click Google Calendar / .ics event addition and interactive venue directions via Google Maps.
- **Instant WhatsApp Sharing:** Optimised mobile performance (under 3-5 MB payload) with rich OpenGraph visual cards when shared in WhatsApp chats.

## Specialized Invitation Categories
- **Digital Wedding Invitations:** Web invitations for modern Indian couples looking for single-link sharing on WhatsApp.
- **Muslim Nikah & Walima Invitations:** Designs featuring emerald parchment, Arabic calligraphy, floral roses, and moonlit mandalas (Emerald Nikah, Noor-e-Zahra, Royal Reception).
- **Hindu Wedding Websites:** Royal Rajasthani palace themes, mandapam vector art, and olive-gold paper envelope styles (Rajwada Royale, Marigold Bhavan, Rajmahal Palace).
- **South Indian Wedding Invites:** Banana leaf accents, brass lamps, and traditional Telugu/Tamil typography (Toran Telugu, Kalyana Mandapam, Tamil Thirumana, Kerala Sands).
- **Christian & Kerala Backwater Invites:** Ivory and gold coastal temple/church vibes (Kerala Sands).
- **Save-The-Date Digital Cards:** Lock in guest calendars 3 to 6 months in advance with interactive countdown web announcements.

## Pricing Tiers
- **Classic Tier (₹999):** Includes Sage Parchment, Marigold Bhavan, Kalyana Mandapam. Standard 24-hour turnaround with couple names, muhurtham, venue maps, calendar integration.
- **Signature Tier (₹1,999):** Includes Royal Reception, Noor-e-Zahra, Kerala Sands, Shubha Vivaham, Toran Telugu, Tamil Thirumana, Emerald Nikah, Meadow Nikah, Midnight Stargaze, Ghibli Portrait, Lake Pichola Royal, Ivory Waltz. Includes custom domain options, photo swap, and 24-hour delivery.
- **Royale Tier (₹2,999):** Includes Rajwada Royale, Rajmahal Palace, Ghibli Selfie, Grand Line Voyage. Includes priority WhatsApp support, custom image hand-edits, and premium opening door / shutter animations.
